name: Collecting a non-final milestone does not change the eligibility counter
description:
Verify eligibility is untouched while the player progresses through milestones before the last one.
Target: service=kinoa-in-app; capability=milestones-eligibility; scope=e2e
precondition:
Published Milestone in-app with 3 milestones and Max Eligibility = 2.
Test player has an active in-app instance with actual_eligibility = 2 and no milestones collected.
expectedResult: Eligibility is decremented only at the final milestone; intermediate collects leave actual_eligibility, the instance ID and the progression intact.

customFields.name: Suite
customFields.value: [KING-18454] As an operator I want to have Eligibility checkboxes for Milestones in-app

steps.body: Reach and collect milestone 1 via the collect-milestones endpoint.

expectedResultSteps.body: Request succeeds; the reward of milestone 1 is granted.
The response contains no in_app key — the claim did not engage.
actual_eligibility is still 2; the instance ID is unchanged; progression reflects milestone 1 as collected.

steps.body: Reach and collect milestone 2 (still not the final one).

expectedResultSteps.body: Request succeeds, no in_app key in the response, actual_eligibility is still 2, progression is not reset.
